why: A May 2026 MDPI paper, 'The Moore Graph of Diameter 2 and Degree 57 via Cyclic Derangements,' proves that a construction using only a cyclic group of permutations is impossible, ruling out a class of candidate constructions for this specific problem; the general existence question remains open per the Wikipedia Moore graph article and a 2024 MDPI paper extended known potential subgraphs from 15 to 20 via computational search.

found.title: The Moore Graph of Diameter 2 and Degree 57 via Cyclic Derangements
found.note: Paper proving that a cyclic-group-based construction of the degree-57 Moore graph is impossible; ruling out a restricted case, not the full question.

found.title: Potential Subgraphs of the Missing Moore Graph
found.note: Computational search extending known potential subgraphs from 15 to 20 using a CP-SAT solver; a search extension, not a resolution.

found.title: Existence of a Moore graph of degree 57 is still open
found.note: Pre-snapshot paper showing a 2020 non-existence proof (arXiv 2010.13443) was flawed; included for context, not counted as post-snapshot movement.
